## Summary

| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|---------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | 1.793 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Assessment

**Champion holds position** — candidate showed better lockbox minimum but significantly worse:
- Tuning minimum (0.05 vs 0.43) — fragile in some folds
- Maximum drawdown (-11.2% vs -9.3%)

## Runloop Status: ✅ Healthy
- 365 iterations completed
- ~9 hours remaining
- No stuck/inconclusive experiments

## Recommended Actions

```bash
# Continue automated exploration (as suggested)
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

No intervention needed — system operating nominally. Will review `next_fix.md` output for potential improvement directions when generated.

- But it **degrades tuning mean and especially tuning min**, and has **worse worst-case drawdown**.  
- Net: it’s a reasonable “PASS” if your gating prioritizes lockbox robustness, but it’s not a clear replacement for the champion given the tail/MDD and tuning collapse.

No “INCONCLUSIVE” candidate currently listed.

### One quick decision note
Unless your promotion rule is explicitly “maximize lockbox min at nearly any cost,” the **current champion still looks safer** due to:
- better tuning mean/min, and
- better worst-case MDD.

If you paste the gating/promote criteria (or the autopilot “selection” scoring), I can tell you whether the PASS candidate is truly promotable under your rules or just “acceptable but not better.”
